question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the passage.

Peak
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Zenith.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"peak"** in the passage refers to** the highest point or apex of something**. In this context, it specifically refers to the peak activity of the Sun in its solar cycle.

 
 
• Example: "As the Sun inches closer to its peak activity in its solar cycle..." In this sentence, "peak" indicates the highest level of solar activity.
 
 
 
• The synonym **"zenith"** also conveys the meaning of **the highest point or culmination of something.**
 
 
• **Example: **The athlete's career reached its **zenith **when she won an Olympic gold medal.​
 
 
 
• Now let's look at the other options:
 
• **Glance: **This word means to take a quick look or glimpse at something. It does not convey the same meaning as "peak" in the passage.
 
 
• Example: "I **glanced **at the clock to see the time before leaving."
 
 
 
• **Point: **While "point" can refer to a specific location or a sharp end of something, it does not capture the meaning of the highest or most intense level, as implied by "peak" in the passage.
 
 
• Example: "She **pointed **out the direction to the nearest subway station."
 
 
 
• **Bottom: **This word refers to the lowest part or the base of something. It is the opposite of "peak" and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
 
• Example: "The rock sank to the **bottom **of the lake."
 
 
 
• In summary, **"zenith"** is the most appropriate synonym for** "peak" **in the passage as it accurately captures the concept of the highest point or culmination of something, in this case, the Sun's peak activity in its solar cycle.
